My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
You and [Mary Arnold](/person/1467) are very decidedly the best this time, so I don’t send any others.
You will have to reform the scheme of travelling as [Mignonette](/person/1637) and [Sparrow Hawk](/person/97) both resign in much haste[^1]
yr affect
Mother Goose


[^1]: The circulation of essays between the various members of the [Gosling Society](/topic/104) caused endless trouble.
